plans.name: Pay as you go (AI Voice Agents)
Pay as you go (AI Chat Agents)

notes: The voice price is per minute ("/ min for AI Voice Agents", line 107) and the chat price is per message ("/ msg for AI Chat Agents", line 109). The page says "Retell starts at $0" with no annual contracts (line 100) and "No platform fees" (line 732). The total voice rate is built from separate parts: Retell Voice Infra $0.055/minute (line 267), text-to-speech from $0.015/minute (line 272), LLM rates that vary by model (lines 295-420), and Retell Twilio/Telnyx telephony at $0.015/min in the default view (line 438). There is "No Charge for Sip Trunking/Custom Telephony" (line 434). Add-ons are priced separately (lines 440-462). Monthly items: Retell Phone Numbers $2.00/month (line 573), Retell SMS $20.00/month (line 576), Verified Phone Number $10.00/Phone number/month (line 584). A second copy of the Verified Phone Number entry adds "One-time $10 fee" (line 727). That is a fee per verified number, not a platform setup fee, so it is not recorded as one. Things that don't match on the page: (1) Enterprise concurrency is "High Cap on Concurrent Calls" (line 132), "No Cap on Concurrent Calls" (line 231), and "custom concurrency starting at 50+ calls" (line 752). (2) Chat is listed as "$0.002+" per message (line 108), but the model table has cheaper rates, e.g. GPT 5 nano $0.0005/AI msg (line 516). (3) The Knowledge Base subscription appears twice: "$80/month free value (10 KBs)" / "$8.00/Knowledge Base/month (prorated)" (lines 581-582) and "$8.00/Knowledge Base/month" / "Free for first 10 knowledge bases" (lines 723-724). (4) The cost estimator's model list (lines 141-159) doesn't match the component pricing table, and its default total shows $0.11 (line 213) labeled "per month" (line 211), though it is a per-minute cost. LLM billing rule: calls under 10 seconds with a dynamic greeting are billed as 10 seconds (line 424), and prompts over 4,000 tokens increase billed time proportionally (line 427).

free_trial.text: Go live in minutes with $10 in free credits. Full platform access, no commitments.
